# Benchmark results (generated by `scripts/benchmark.py`)

Run at: 2026-11-14T19:38:15

## Environment

- PostgreSQL: 17.12 (running locally, same host as the script, no network)
- Host: Linux-6.18.44-fc-v470-x86_64-with-glibc2.39; CPU: Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.10GHz; logical CPUs: 1; RAM: 3992 MiB
- Settings (defaults, not tuned): shared_buffers=128MB, work_mem=4MB, effective_cache_size=4GB, random_page_cost=4, max_parallel_workers_per_gather=2
- Python 3.12.3; method: 15 timed runs per query after 3 warm-ups (warm cache); reported value = **median** of PostgreSQL's own `Execution Time` from `EXPLAIN (ANALYZE)`
- `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` adds instrumentation overhead, so absolute times are slightly higher than an un-instrumented query; the before/after comparison uses identical instrumentation.

## Dataset (synthetic)

| table | rows |
|---|---|
| users | 2,000 |
| projects | 200 |
| project_memberships | 4,000 |
| tasks | 400,000 |

- tasks table size (heap + TOAST): 60 MB; target project holds 2,000 tasks, 1,020 with status TODO
- seeding took 8.9s. Tasks are interleaved across projects, ~70% assigned, ~20% without due date.

## Results: median execution time, before vs after indexing

| Query | Endpoint / purpose | Without indexes | With indexes | Speed-up | Plan without | Plan with |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| Q1 status filter + newest first | GET /projects/{id}/tasks?status=TODO (default sort, page 1) | 32.218 ms | 0.037 ms | 870.8x | `Limit > Gather Merge > Sort > Seq Scan(tasks)` | `Limit > Incremental Sort > Index Scan(ix_tasks_project_id_created_at)` |
| Q2 sort by due date | GET /projects/{id}/tasks?sort_by=due_date&order=asc | 26.386 ms | 0.030 ms | 879.5x | `Limit > Gather Merge > Sort > Seq Scan(tasks)` | `Limit > Incremental Sort > Index Scan(ix_tasks_project_id_due_date)` |
| Q3 newest first, deep page | GET /projects/{id}/tasks?page=3 (default sort) | 26.824 ms | 0.044 ms | 609.6x | `Limit > Gather Merge > Sort > Seq Scan(tasks)` | `Limit > Incremental Sort > Index Scan(ix_tasks_project_id_created_at)` |
| Q4 count per status | total for a filtered list / dashboard counter | 32.177 ms | 0.078 ms | 412.5x | `Aggregate > Gather > Aggregate > Seq Scan(tasks)` | `Aggregate > Index Only Scan(ix_tasks_project_id_status)` |
| Q5 due-date window | GET /projects/{id}/tasks?due_after=...&due_before=... | 40.760 ms | 0.031 ms | 1314.8x | `Limit > Gather Merge > Sort > Seq Scan(tasks)` | `Limit > Incremental Sort > Index Scan(ix_tasks_project_id_due_date)` |
| Q6 assigned to user (all projects) | 'my tasks' lookup; also the FK ON DELETE SET NULL action when a member is removed | 28.122 ms | 0.164 ms | 171.5x | `Limit > Gather Merge > Sort > Seq Scan(tasks)` | `Limit > Sort > Bitmap Heap Scan(tasks) > Bitmap Index Scan(ix_tasks_assigned_to)` |
| C1 control: membership lookup | authorization check on every request (unique index, present in both phases) | 0.007 ms | 0.006 ms | 1.2x | `Index Scan(uq_project_memberships_project_user)` | `Index Scan(uq_project_memberships_project_user)` |
| C2 control: user by email | login (unique index, present in both phases) | 0.008 ms | 0.006 ms | 1.3x | `Index Scan(uq_users_email)` | `Index Scan(uq_users_email)` |

Control queries (C1, C2) are served by unique indexes in both phases and should not change; differences there are measurement noise and give a feel for the noise floor.

## Cost of the indexes

| Index | Size | Build time on 400k rows |
|---|---|---|
| ix_tasks_project_id_status | 4368 kB | 287 ms |
| ix_tasks_assigned_to | 4088 kB | 201 ms |
| ix_tasks_project_id_created_at | 17 MB | 345 ms |
| ix_tasks_project_id_due_date | 6008 kB | 284 ms |

Bulk `INSERT` of 20,000 task rows (median of 3, rolled back): **305 ms without** the four indexes vs **471 ms with** them (1.54x).
